# getSheetByIndex

<link-summary>Finds a sheet by its position in the spreadsheet.</link-summary>

<web-summary>getSheetByIndex() — Finds a sheet by its position in the spreadsheet. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code></p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function getSheetByIndex(
  sheetIndex: number,
  spreadsheet?: GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Spreadsheet | undefined | null
): GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet | null;
```

The index counts from zero, left to right as the tabs are shown. It is a position, not an identity: moving a tab changes what this returns, which is why `getSheetById` is the one to store.

An index past the end gives `null` rather than an exception.

## Parameters

| Parameter                  | Type                                                            | Description                                            |
| :------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------- |
| `sheetIndex`               | `number`                                                        | The zero-based position.                               |
| `spreadsheet` _(optional)_ | `GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Spreadsheet \| undefined \| null` | The spreadsheet to look in. The active one by default. |

## Returns

`GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet | null` — the sheet, or `null` when the index is past the end.

## Examples

### Looking up

```javascript
const first = getSheetByIndex(0);
```
